searchText: Is there any channel for single-slot-finality Qs? There's some small telegrams, not really a public one yet I guess the intention was that this channel covers SSF? for now yah, I'd use this Current proposal of single-slot finality requires slot times of 16 sec. Current beacon node impl rely heavily on constant slot times. Is there any idea to reduce the messiness of transitioning 12 -> 16 or we'll have to deal with it? moving to SSF or PBS both are deep architectural changes that would certainly mess with slot times. I don't currently have a clean proposal on that shift, but I suspect that it's only one of many things that is painful... :/ if/when a "regenesis" type strategy that throws out the old logic in a live mainnet client might help clean up some of that kind of stuff but without getting deeper into specs, it's hard to say switch to verkle, 16s/s, drop selfdestruct is one re-genesis sounds liberating Dropping selfdestruct can be done ahead of time; should be asap imo But yeah, I can see the gains from bundling changes
